{{Quote|Oh, oh… no, no, sir. Not again. Please, no.|A Troglof server, to a Hutt|<ref name="SC 105" />|audio=EatingTroglof.mp3}}
During the [[New Republic Era]], a '''Troglof''' worked as an attendant at<ref name="SC 105" /> [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]]<ref name="Spa name">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/bj8gqtnvm799njt6mjc6t|text=GR-FF-001420|date=2024-12-23}}</ref> on the [[planet]] of [[Lanupa]].<ref name="SC 105" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> he<ref name="SC 105 AD" /> tended to a [[Unidentified Hutt (Lanupa)|male Hutt]] who was taking a [[mud bath]] in the facility. The attendant brought the [[Hutt]] a tray of [[foodstuff]], humming along the way and bowing to them before presenting the meal. Upon closer examination, however, the guest rejected the food and instead helped themselves to the attendant. When grasped in the Hutt's hand, the [[Troglof]] pleaded with them not to do so again<ref name="SC 105" /> before he finally ended up eaten by the guest.<ref name="Wainerdi:2024" />

The [[spa]] attendant was a [[Color|gray]]-skinned [[Troglof]]. He had an elongated and rounded head, with the [[eye]]s located on appendages that protruded from the top of his head. He wore his dark-gray hair combed back into a single plait and sported a beige [[Clothing|tunic]] adorned with patterned stripes.<ref name="SC 105" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Troglof spa attendant debuted in "[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]],"<ref name="SC 105" /> a ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' episode that premiered on [[December 25]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref> As revealed by series sound editor [[David W. Collins]], he was voiced by series co-creator [[Christopher Ford]].<ref name="Wainerdi:2024">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-skywalker-sound-interview|text=The Strange and Familiar Sounds of ''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew''|author=Brandon Wainerdi|date=2024-12-26}}</ref>
